_note: Example lines only (Q6 decides the launch set). Copy is draft; no claims beyond describing the service.

lines.name: Home nursing
lines.when: A parent is coming home after surgery or a long stay and needs wound care, injections or a drip at home.
lines.covers: Visits or shifts by a nurse, following the treating doctor's instructions.

lines.name: Physiotherapy and rehab
lines.when: After a fracture, a stroke or a joint replacement, when getting to a clinic is hard.
lines.covers: Sessions at home with a physiotherapist, planned around the doctor's advice.

lines.name: Equipment on rent
lines.when: The doctor has asked for a hospital bed, oxygen or a wheelchair at home.
lines.covers: Delivery and set-up of the equipment the plan needs, for as long as it is needed.
